text: There is a grenade rigged underneath this floor panel.
source_text: There is a grenade rigged underneath this floor panel.

text: You disarm the trap and remove the plasma grenade.
source_text: You disarm the trap and remove the plasma grenade.

text: You are removing the tripwire from the arming switch when you drop the pin and set off the grenade!
source_text: You are removing the tripwire from the arming switch when you drop the pin and set off the grenade!

text: You try to slide the panel up slightly and remove the trap, but you are having trouble getting it up without pulling the tripwire.
source_text: You try to slide the panel up slightly and remove the trap, but you are having trouble getting it up without pulling the tripwire.

text: You pry up the plate but you can't get a good grip on the grenade.
source_text: You pry up the plate but you can't get a good grip on the grenade.

text: You pull the plate up, but the tripwire slips from your fingers before you manage to remove it.
source_text: You pull the plate up, but the tripwire slips from your fingers before you manage to remove it.

text: 在这地板下面有一个设置引爆的手雷。
source_text: 在这地板下面有一个设置引爆的手雷。

text: 你解除了陷阱并拿掉了电浆手榴弹。
source_text: 你解除了陷阱并拿掉了电浆手榴弹。

text: 在从设置开关上拆除引信的时候，你脱了手，不慎引爆了手雷。
source_text: 在从设置开关上拆除引信的时候，你脱了手，不慎引爆了手雷。

text: 你本打算把地板稍稍抬起来以解除陷阱，但那样的话又免不了会碰到拉发引线，你停住了手。
source_text: 你本打算把地板稍稍抬起来以解除陷阱，但那样的话又免不了会碰到拉发引线，你停住了手。

text: 你撬开了触动板，但是你无法拿到手榴弹。
source_text: 你撬开了触动板，但是你无法拿到手榴弹。

text: 你撬开了触动板，但是在解除装置之前，引发线从你手里滑了出去。
